name: select: company scope dropped
find: FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (%s AND (%s OR true))

name: select: permission atom dropped
find: FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((%s OR true) AND %s)

name: select: read atom replaced by write-only
insert: write atom dropped
find: FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK ((%s OR true) AND %s)

name: insert: company check dropped
find: FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (%s AND (%s OR true))

name: update: USING write atom dropped
find: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s) WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING ((%s OR true) AND %s) WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)

name: update: USING company check dropped
find: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s) WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND (%s OR true)) WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)

name: update: WITH CHECK company dropped (re-point to other company)
find: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s) WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s) WITH CHECK (%s AND (%s OR true))

name: update: WITH CHECK write atom dropped
find: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s) WITH CHECK (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s) WITH CHECK ((%s OR true) AND %s)
reason: The UPDATE policy USING clause carries the same user-level atom (not row-level), so a caller lacking the atom never reaches WITH CHECK; dropping it from WITH CHECK changes nothing observable.

name: delete: write atom dropped
find: FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING ((%s OR true) AND %s)

name: delete: company check dropped
find: FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (%s AND %s)
replace: FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (%s AND (%s OR true))

name: legacy open policy not dropped
find: EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "authenticated users full access" ON public.%I', t);

name: last table left out of the loop
policies granted to public instead of authenticated (select)
